info.title: Cisco IOS-XE Native Config - Application Services
info.description:
Application services and scheduling configuration for Cisco-IOS-XE-native model.

**Modules covered:** kron (job scheduling), app-hosting (IOx), nbar (application recognition), service-discovery, service-routing, mdns-sd (mDNS gateway), pnp (Plug and Play)

**YANG Augments:** Cisco-IOS-XE-kron, Cisco-IOS-XE-app-hosting, Cisco-IOS-XE-nbar, Cisco-IOS-XE-service-discovery, Cisco-IOS-XE-service-routing, Cisco-IOS-XE-mdns-gateway, Cisco-IOS-XE-pnp

get.description:
Retrieve kron job scheduler configuration including occurrence definitions and policy lists.

CLI equivalent: `show running-config | section kron`

YANG module: Cisco-IOS-XE-kron

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Limit the depth of returned sub-tree data (RFC 8040 Section 4.8.2). Use 'unbounded' for full depth.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Select specific fields to return (RFC 8040 Section 4.8.3). Example: fields=name;status

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: Filter by config state: 'config' (config true only), 'nonconfig' (config false only), or 'all'.

put.description:
Replace all kron scheduler definitions.

CLI equivalent: `kron occurrence BACKUP-DAILY at 23:00 recurring`

patch.description: Merge update to kron scheduler definitions.
